## The problem
Encountering an error attempting to set the HVAC mode on a given Native Zone:
"Failed to call service climate/set_hvac_mode. 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable."


## Environment
- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.108.3
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 
- Operating environment (Home Assistant/Supervised/Docker/venv): Home Assistant Docker
- Integration causing this issue: Nexia
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/nexia/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`



```yaml
nexia:
  username: MYUSERNAME
  password: MYPASSWORD
```
